This model of Ebola virus is magnified 1 million times, though only 1-2% of it is visible. A helix of protein (yellow) encloses the virus’s genetic material (pink). One Ebola virus may contain up to ten identical packets of genetic material.

This model was created using CellPACK.

This model was created using CellPACK.
